source: Project-authored layout, two added foliose forms and common material response; no new paid or third-party download
reef: Lower original sample bommies and connected slope, retaining horizontal footprints and original mesh topology. Refit complete coral, resident and sediment scenery geometry to the real altered surfaces. Four authored foliose forms and existing two open CC0 branching sources are retained.
animals: Existing IDs, species, catalogue sizes, UVs, source textures and animation shaders retained. Shared linear RGB saturation 0.78, roughness 0.66 for standard materials, zero metalness. This is runtime rendering, not edited source photos or new realistic anatomy.
rejected: The first whole-scene candidate's surface coating and reintroduced compact Pocillopora forms were rejected for smeared bare surfaces and stone-like silhouettes. Neither is active in the delivered scene.
limits: Authored habitat and display composition, not surveyed reef coverage or calibrated marine optics. Existing source licences, including turtle non-commercial terms, remain unchanged.
